data.narrative:
Deterrence is a Seed-stage company in Defense & Security that has raised $10M+ to date. The valuation analysis draws from a comp universe of 10 companies—2 public (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private—including same-sector peers UFORCE, Singularity, and NODA AI.

Two triangulation methods apply here. Stage-progression analysis uses the $10M total raised as a valuation proxy, applying a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical for Seed-to-next-stage advancement, yielding $25M. The peer-median method references three same-sector companies at Seed or Series A stage, producing a median valuation of $400M against a range of $125M to $1.0B. The substantial spread reflects heterogeneity within the peer set—UFORCE values at $1.0B while NODA AI values at $125M—both at or near Deterrence's stage.

The triangulated range across both methods spans $21M (low) to $460M (high), with a median of $212M. This wide dispersion reflects tension between capital-deployed valuation ($25M) and peer-derived valuation ($400M median). Key uncertainties driving the range include the applicability of late-stage or mega-funded peers to an early-stage company, and whether the $10M raised proxy adequately reflects Deterrence's assets, IP, or market position. Resolution of product-market fit and customer traction would materially narrow this band. The median of $212M provides a reasonable central case pending additional stage-specific data.
